title: Required Organization and Product JSON-LD was not present in sampled pages
observation: The captured JSON-LD artifacts are empty arrays on the homepage and Glucare Plus product page at desktop and mobile viewports.

impact.business: Search and assistant systems lack the requested structured product and organization declarations in these samples.
impact.seo: Organization and Product JSON-LD required by the checklist was not observed.
impact.technical: No JSON-LD object was returned by the sampled page collectors.

suggested_direction: Add structured data that matches visible, verifiable page content and validate it against current parsers.
unknowns: Only JSON-LD was tested; this does not rule out other structured data formats.
specialist_interpretation: The captured JSON-LD artifacts are empty arrays on the homepage and Glucare Plus product page at desktop and mobile viewports.
limitations: Only JSON-LD was tested; this does not rule out other structured data formats.
